title: Trust, Layered: Warranted AI Knowledge Extraction for Interpretive Corpora, Demonstrated on Jung's Collected Works (dataset, pipeline, and paper)
description: A warranted atlas of C. G. Jung's Collected Works: 589 nodes, 2091 edges, 2678 references over nine volumes, each reference anchored to a numbered paragraph with a verbatim quote of at most 25 words, gated by a model of a different family from the proposer, cross-vendor audited (93% of references, every batch since the pre-merge mandate), with a normalization layer (260 relations) and a relation-family layer (ruleset v0.7.2, calibration record pipeline/family_calibration/records/2026-08-13_v072_run4.json, PASS) that inherit no warrant from the claim beneath. Every claim carries a warrant profile: the checks it survived, who made them, and which nobody has made. Includes the paper (Trust, Layered), the full transaction ledger, all experiment inputs, verdicts and adjudications (E0-E10, Studies B and C), the family calibration records, and the James pilot. Graph v2.0 · ruleset v0.7.2 · calibration record 2026-08-13_v072_run4 (PASS). Supersedes v1.3, which is retained as the artifact the July 2026 paper and arXiv v1 describe. Copyrighted source texts are not included; quotations are <=25 words under quotation exceptions (see docs/LEGAL.md). Live atlas: https://symbolicworld.observer
